title: Item classification, prompt cls-v2
description: Strict response schema for one line item. The model receives only the cleaned description, the merchant name and the MCC, never the declared expense type or the attendee count (FR-007). The restricted flag is derived from the taxonomy by code, not returned by the model. Decisions: subtype is A6, the recipient fields are A9.

subtype.description: Must be none unless category is other.

recipient_name.description: The name the line gives for whom the item is for, normalised; null if none.
